scientific_summary: Methodology-grounded SVG evidence and settled content feed Director-owned colour and layout decisions, which compile to one image call and independent pixel inspection.
invariants: References supply drawing evidence; Methodology supplies scientific content.
A separate complete SVG supplies palette observations, not a fixed library.
Director owns the final source-derived palette, grouping, routes and exact content.
Preflight and compact prompt compilation occur before one image call.
Artifact checks do not certify actual pixels. No automatic repair loop.
layout: Five unequal white regions in one row. Director largest; evidence second largest; method, compiler and output compact. Four straight arrows. White title/subtitle above. All action text and warning within frames.
typography: Black Arial or similar clear sans-serif. Bold region headings; regular inner labels. No grey microcopy or very large headings that crowd contents.

placements.placement: Compact white document region; methodology and requirements, one outgoing scientific brief.
Larger white region with two slim evidence sheets above a need-to-drawing table and a dedicated complete-palette strip. Light blue only on evidence marks.

Largest white region. Upper third: colour relationship swatches with ample white spacing. Centre: a miniature asymmetric three-region sketch with simple connecting lines. Lower third: a small exact-label sheet. Warm tint only within the miniature mechanism and decision strip.
White medium region with a narrow compact-prompt sheet and three plain check rows; no green badges or giant ticks.
White compact region with one small schematic generated-figure thumbnail and an eye/inspection outline; no actual case artwork or unsupported model names.
